  [
   {
    "title": "free p leaves an active, exercisable access on storage owned by p, which is no longer usable; endUse rejects the same state",
    "severity": "major",
    "location": "formal/Ern/MM03.lean:2804-2831 (FreeAccessOK, FreeAnchorOK, FreePre pin clause); compare EndingLeaf/EndUseAccessOK at 2666-2685",
    "cause": "Missing coverage, possibly a spec defect. FreeAccessOK, FreeAnchorOK and the pin clause of FreePre only look at `footprint s.P p`. But `free p` also makes every place owned by p unusable, because the owner chain now runs into a dead place (A5 Usable). freeS also releases the roots of those places, since they are held within p. A frame-held access derived from such a root therefore survives with an inactive origin, and read3/write3 still accept it on a place that is no longer Usable. endUse handles exactly this case through EndingLeaf, which covers places that stop being usable; free does not. A6 words both preconditions the same way ('aucune autorité active dérivée sur son empreinte détenue ailleurs'), yet the module applies them differently. A5 says 'Un emplacement possédé n'est pas nécessairement une allocation distincte de MM-02', so milestone 1 does not settle whether the nested storage survives the free physically. free_no_dangling holds only because it is limited to the leaves of p.",
    "evidence": "Scratch file /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guygouri-Devlab-ernlang-ern/c986905c-e900-4fd9-bebc-4a3ce7ebb180/scratchpad/review3/F1.lean; `lake env lean` exits 0 with no output.
```
-- frame 1: 0 value v (frame-owned), 1 owned root p (owner place 0), 2 storage owned by p
def f1a : S3 := enter1 [(none, none, 0), (none, some 0, 0), (none, some 1, 0)]
def f1b : S3 := write3Eff f1a [2]
def f1c : S3 := deriveEff f1b 2 2 .observe      -- authority 3, held by frame 1
def f1d : S3 := freeEff f1c 1
example : Reachable KF f1d := .free (p := 1) (auth := 7) (.derive (src := 2) (q := 2) (m := .observe) (.write (a := 2) (ls := [2]) (.enter (ps := []) (ls := [(none, none, 0), (none, some 0, 0), (none, some 1, 0)]) .init (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))
example : FreeStep KF 1 7 f1c (.ok f1d) := .ok (by decide)
example : ¬ f1d.Usable 2 ∧ ¬ f1d.Active 2 ∧ f1d.Active 3 ∧ f1d.dead 1 = true := by decide
example : Read3Step 3 [2] f1d (.ok f1d) := .ok (by decide)
example : EndUseStep KF 1 f1c .reject := .reject (by decide)   -- endUse of the same p is rejected
-- Modify variant: the write is accepted after the free
example : Write3Step 3 [2] (freeEff (deriveEff f1b 2 2 .modify) 1) (.ok _) := ...  -- checked: ok
-- usable dependent anchored on that access stays 'valid':
example : (freeEff f1f 1).Usable 3 ∧ ¬ (freeEff f1f 1).Usable 2 ∧ (freeEff f1f 1).D 3 = [4] ∧ (freeEff f1f 1).Active 4 := by decide
-- pinned nested storage: free accepted, endUse rejected
example : FreeStep KF 1 7 (pinEff f1b 2 true) (.ok (freeEff (pinEff f1b 2 true) 1)) := .ok (by decide)
example : EndUseStep KF 1 (pinEff f1b 2 true) .reject := .reject (by decide)
```
The origin of the surviving access is released while that access is still active. An explicit `release` can never produce this state, because O3.2 requires 'Aucun descendant actif ne dépend encore de cette autorité'.",
    "fix": "Make free consider the places that stop being usable, as EndingLeaf does for endUse, in all three clauses: derived access, anchor and pin. Otherwise have A6 state explicitly what free does to the places owned by p."
   },
   {
    "title": "exitFrame accepts a frame whose local is pinned without ExternalDone, while endUse and transfer of that local are rejected",
    "severity": "major",
    "location": "formal/Ern/MM03.lean:976-983 (ExitPre); 991-998 (exitEff)",
    "cause": "Missing coverage, and the spec is silent. ExitPre has no pin clause. A8 lists only transfer, free, endUse and unpin, but the exit ends the storage of the locals that were not transferred (O7: 'Fin de validité des emplacements locaux non transférés'). Pinned storage can therefore have its storage ended while still registered (the DMA case). I5 says 'Le stockage couvert par une obligation d'épinglage active ne peut subir de déplacement physique incompatible avec cette obligation' and is to be checked 'dans les opérations concernées'. Spec §11 case 13 expects 'Déplacement physique interdit pendant l'enregistrement'.",
    "evidence": "Scratch file /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guygouri-Devlab-ernlang-ern/c986905c-e900-4fd9-bebc-4a3ce7ebb180/scratchpad/review3/F2.lean; `lake env lean` exits 0.
```
def f2a : S3 := pinEff c13a 0 true
example : PinStep 0 c13a (.ok f2a) := .ok (by decide)
example : EndUseStep K0 0 f2a .reject := .reject (by decide)
example : TransferStep K0 0 1 f2a .reject := .reject (by decide)
example : ExitStep f2a (.ok (exitEff f2a)) := .ok (by decide)
example : (exitEff f2a).pin 0 = true ∧ ¬ (exitEff f2a).Usable 0 := by decide
-- static pin: endUse rejected, exit accepted
example : EndUseStep (KT [] [0] [] [] []) 0 c13a .reject := .reject (by decide)
example : ExitStep c13a (.ok (exitEff c13a)) := .ok (by decide)
-- callee version: frame 2 pins its own local 2 and returns
def f2b : S3 := write3Eff (enterEff c13a [] [(none, none, 0)]) [2]
example : PinStep 2 f2b (.ok (pinEff f2b 2 true)) := .ok (by decide)
example : EndUseStep K0 2 (pinEff f2b 2 true) .reject := .reject (by decide)
example : ExitStep (pinEff f2b 2 true) (.ok (exitEff (pinEff f2b 2 true))) := .ok (by decide)
```
Note that ExitStep of c13a is accepted even when K.Pinned 0 holds, because ExitStep does not depend on `k`.",
    "fix": "Either add to ExitPre: no leaf of a place that stops being usable at the exit is pinned (dynamically or by K.Pinned) without ExternalDone. Or have the arbitration state that exitFrame is outside A8, and report the case."
   },
   {
    "title": "endUse of the holder of a block leaves an access derived from that block usable (read and write) with an inactive origin",
    "severity": "minor",
    "location": "formal/Ern/MM03.lean:2651-2658 (endUseS releases authorities held in p), 2682-2685 (EndUseAccessOK limited to ending leaves)",
    "cause": "Spec defect, or a choice the model does not state. A6 limits the endUse precondition to 'l'empreinte de p', and its effect releases the 'autorités encore détenues par p'. When p holds a block (A10), accesses derived from that block cover the region, not the footprint of p. They are therefore not checked, they survive the endUse of the value, and their origin is released. That release would be rejected by O3.2. The effect stays contained: reset and a re-issue of the region remain blocked by this orphaned access. It is still a use of a right after the final event of the value that carried it.",
    "evidence": "Scratch file /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guygouri-Devlab-ernlang-ern/c986905c-e900-4fd9-bebc-4a3ce7ebb180/scratchpad/review3/F3.lean; `lake env lean` exits 0.
```
-- c6b.1 (case 6): block 4 on [2], held by place 4
def f3a : S3 := deriveEff c6b.1 4 2 .modify     -- authority 5 derived from the block, frame-held
def f3b : S3 := endUseEff f3a 4
example : DeriveStep 4 2 .modify c6b.1 (.ok f3a) := .ok (by decide)
example : EndUseStep KA 4 f3a (.ok f3b) := .ok (by decide)
example : ¬ f3b.Active 4 ∧ f3b.Active 5 ∧ f3b.org 5 = some 4 := by decide
example : Write3Step 5 [2] f3b (.ok (write3Eff f3b [2])) := .ok (by decide)
example : Read3Step 5 [2] (write3Eff f3b [2]) (.ok (write3Eff f3b [2])) := .ok (by decide)
example : ReleaseStep 4 f3a .reject := .reject (by decide)   -- explicit release refused (O3.2)
```
O3: 'Une valeur qui perd son dernier droit d'accès exploitable ne peut pas continuer à utiliser ce droit par un ancien chemin.'",
    "fix": "Report to the arbitration whether endUse and free must also reject active descendants, held elsewhere, of the authorities they release. If they must, extend EndUseAccessOK and FreeAccessOK to those descendants."

- The Lake project is in `formal/`. `formal/DESIGN.md` governs how to formalize, never what the semantics is. Propose design decisions it does not settle in your report; never take them silently.
- Every definition or theorem that encodes a spec rule cites the rule's location in its docstring.
- A definition says what its rule says. Never make a definition more permissive, add an unjustified hypothesis or narrow a theorem's domain to obtain a proof.
- Never change a theorem statement, or a definition it depends on, to make a proof go through. If stuck, stop and report the goal state.

Spec passages implemented (by location), what changed, what is unproven or open, spec problems found.

Adversarial and read-only. For each change, check:

- It says exactly what the spec says: not stronger, not weaker. Read definitions, hypotheses and quantifiers, not only proofs. A theorem that holds because a definition is too permissive or its hypotheses are unsatisfiable is blocking.
- Each formalized rule cites its spec location.
- No theorem statement or dependency was changed without the task allowing it.
- No interpretation was chosen silently where the spec is unclear.
- Nothing outside the task was added.

When a milestone is declared complete, compare the rules in its announced scope with the spec locations cited in `formal/`, and list every rule left without a definition or theorem.

Every finding needs evidence: a spec quote, a counterexample or command output. No evidence, no finding. Never ask for additions beyond the task.

Output: verdict (block / changes / ok), then each finding with severity, location, cause (formalization error, missing coverage or spec defect) and evidence.
